turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hello Leander, I can help you find your order. Please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot look up orders by name. To find your order, I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Without them I cannot share any order details, including the status or tracking link. You can find the order number in your order confirmation email, and then send it along with the email address to continue.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I am sorry, Leander, but I cannot share the delivery address or shipping status without verifying the order. I need both the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Once you send both, I can check the order for you.
